rows.current: text: 抓我的家伙手里有什么发着怪光，可我太专注于伺候那根发光的鸡巴，没顾上看清那是什么。

rows.speaker: narrator

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Everything is kind of a blur after I had gotten that dick in my mouth.
rows.current: text: 含住那根鸡巴后，一切就变得模模糊糊了。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I remember being picked up by some other folks... I think?
rows.current: text: 我记得后来有别的家伙把我抱起来了……大概吧？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Either way, I was being jammed down on this thick hot glowing dick repeatedly!
rows.current: text: 反正他们不停把我往那根粗热、发光的鸡巴上猛按！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I can't even recall how long I was bred for, but I sure felt drained after.
rows.current: text: 记不清被干了多久，反正完事后我彻底被榨干了。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Too out of it to even see whose hands slipped me into shackles or lifted my tail.
rows.current: text: 我恍惚得都看不清，是谁给我戴上镣铐、抬起尾巴。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I couldn't even turn my head to see what was making lusty growling sounds either!
rows.current: text: 我连转头看看是谁在色欲熏心地低吼都做不到！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: It seems like not even magnificent specimens as the Swipers are immune
rows.current: text: 看来连挥爪这种出色的物种，也挡不住这美味又完美的棉尾翘臀！！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: to delectable perfect cotton tailed asses!!

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Day after day they've taken turns, doing their best to keep me satisfied! Hee!Hee!
rows.current: text: 他们天天轮着来，拼命让我满足！嘻！嘻！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: They did a pretty good job, I gotta say. Definitely in my top three tops.
rows.current: text: 不得不说，他们干得真不错，在我最喜欢的攻里绝对排得进前三。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Something about those barbs raking in and out juuuuust soooo... mmmh!
rows.current: text: 那些倒刺来回刮蹭，恰——到好处……嗯唔！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Boy, I hope you weren't too rough on the Swiper guarding me, Yiffai!
rows.current: text: 伊吠，你没把看守我的挥爪揍得太惨吧！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I wouldn't mind one last date with him before I head out of here, hee-!
rows.current: text: 离开前再跟他约会一次，我可不介意，嘻——！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Oh brave hero, thank you for rescuing me and proving your courage.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 勇敢的英雄啊，感谢你救出我，证明了你的勇气。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Now, place your hands upon mine.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 现在，把你的双手放在我的手上。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Turn your mind inward and witness the events that have shaped these lands...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 将心神转向内在，见证塑造这片土地的往事……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...I can see...!
rows.current: text: ……我能看见了……！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: We, the Fenfen, have lived for eons on this planet that you know as "Tutone".
rows.current: lang(Fox): 我们Fenfen，在你们称作“图托恩”的星球上已生活了无数岁月。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Having eschewed the sort of technological advances that your culture thrives on
rows.current: lang(Fox): 摒弃了你们的文化赖以繁荣的那类技术进步之后，

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: we have lived simple, satisfying lives in harmony with the planet itself.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 我们与星球本身和谐共处，过着简单而满足的生活。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Quiet and modest are the best ways to describe us Fenfen.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 安静谦逊，最适合形容我们Fenfen。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: All major quarrels were sorted out by a council of the wisest ESPers we had.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 所有重大争端，都由我们最睿智的超能力者组成的议会裁决。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: With our highly attuned senses and powers, we were able to find solutions that
rows.current: lang(Fox): 凭借敏锐的感官与力量，我们总能找到办法，

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: benefitted all of society at once.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 能让整个社会一同受益。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: However, even with our attunement...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 然而，即便有着这份感应力……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...we were not able to sense that amongst us ESPers lay one whose ambitions
rows.current: lang(Fox): ……我们竟未察觉，超能力者之中藏着一人，其野心

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: would throw the very planet itself into chaos...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 会令整颗星球陷入混乱……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.current: lang(Fox): ……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...her name was Traeh.
rows.current: lang(Fox): ……她的名字是Traeh。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Gifted beyond her years, with an uncanny ability to find solutions others missed
rows.current: lang(Fox): 她年纪轻轻就天赋过人，总能想到别人想不到的办法，

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: the ESPer Traeh seemed like a fine addition to the council.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 超能力者Traeh看上去会是议会的一位得力新成员。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: She was readily granted access to the stores of power that we Fenfen kept.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 她顺利获准接触我们Fenfen储存的力量。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Power... that she then proceeded to corrupt.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 力量……而她随即着手将其腐化。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Absorbing ancient caches of ESPer power that were left by previous generations
rows.current: lang(Fox): 吸收了前代遗留下来的古老超能力者力量贮藏之后，

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Traeh was left deeply disfigured, down to her very core.
rows.current: lang(Fox): Traeh从外貌到内心，都已扭曲得面目全非。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Maybe if we, the remaining elder ESPers of the council, reacted faster
rows.current: lang(Fox): 也许我们议会中剩下的超能力者长老若能更快应对

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: then we could've prevented the calamity that was about to befall our people.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 或许就能阻止那场即将降临族人的浩劫。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Alas, we did not, and that will forever be our greatest failing...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 可惜我们没有，这永远是我们最大的过失……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Now go, destined hero.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 去吧，命定的英雄。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Free my brothers and sisters and restore peace to the land!
rows.current: lang(Fox): 解救我的兄弟姐妹，让这片土地重归安宁！

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Oh brave hero, thank you for rescuing me and proving your courage.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 勇敢的英雄啊，感谢你救出我，证明了你的勇气。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Now, place your hands upon mine.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 现在，把你的双手放在我的手上。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Turn your mind inward and witness the events that have shaped these lands...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 将心神转向内在，见证塑造这片土地的往事……

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: As dark forces descended on all Fenfen, young and old alike,
rows.current: lang(Fox): 当黑暗势力降临到全体Fenfen——无论老幼——头上时，

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: it truly did seem like all hope was lost.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 那时，仿佛一切希望都已破灭。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Powerful though the ESPers of our people may have been, violence was unknown to us.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 我们族中的超能力者纵然或许强大，暴力对我们却全然陌生。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Only when pushed to the end of options, when even surrender seemed impossible
rows.current: lang(Fox): 直到被逼得走投无路，甚至连投降都不可能时，

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: did the first of us strike out...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 我们中才终于有人率先反击……

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: ...and retaliate!
rows.current: lang(Fox): ……并奋起反击！

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Psychic abilities once turned only towards a common good
rows.current: lang(Fox): 曾经只用于共同福祉的心灵能力，

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: would now be turned against those who would try to subjugate us Fenfen!
rows.current: lang(Fox): 如今要用来反抗那些妄图奴役我们Fenfen的敌人！

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: An arsenal of ESPer abilities became harnessed as weapons of war.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 超能力者的能力武库被征用为战争的武器。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Explosive psychic projectiles blasted away foes.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 爆裂的灵能弹将敌人轰飞。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Punishing waves of telekinetic force prevented advancement of armies.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 强劲的念动力波阻住了大军的推进。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Some even went so far as to transform their very bodies into tools for combat.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 有些人甚至把自己的身体变成了战斗兵器。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Ancient beings heard the cries of mental anguish that rang throughout the planet
rows.current: lang(Fox): 古老的存在们听见了回荡于整颗星球的精神痛呼，

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Some, like the noble Elves, took up ancient weapons in order to aid us Fenfen...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 有些如高贵的精灵，拿起古老兵器援助我们Fenfen……

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: ...while other ancient beings, from deep within the bowels of the planet
rows.current: lang(Fox): ……而其他古老的存在，则从这颗星球最深的地底，

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: awoke with a desire for vengeance and domination of their own...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 带着属于它们自己的复仇与征服欲望苏醒了……

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Oh brave hero, thank you for rescuing me and proving your courage.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 勇敢的英雄啊，感谢你救出我，证明了你的勇气。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Now, place your hands upon mine.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 现在，把你的双手放在我的手上。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Turn your mind inward and witness the events that have shaped these lands...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 将心神转向内在，见证塑造这片土地的往事……

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: As us Fenfen strove to rebuild our home and drive out the remnants of evil
rows.current: lang(Fox): 当我们Fenfen努力重建家园、驱逐邪恶的残余势力时，

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: some of us looked up into the sky and saw a shooting star coming down.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 我们当中有人仰望天空，看见一颗流星正向下坠落。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Perhaps Fate had sent us a hero, with which we could regain our peace?
rows.current: lang(Fox): 或许是命运为我们送来了一位英雄，让我们能借助这位英雄重获安宁？

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Or perhaps Fate had a more sinister joke to play on us suffering Fenfen
rows.current: lang(Fox): 又或许，命运还想对饱受苦难的我们Fenfen开一个更加阴险的玩笑，

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: for this visitor from the stars did not land on our planet proper...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 因为这位来自群星的访客并没有降落在我们的星球本身……

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: ...instead, they landed on the satellite rock that held Traeh's prison!
rows.current: lang(Fox): ……而是降落在了那颗设有Traeh监牢的岩石卫星上！

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: As if destined for only a single purpose, the interstellar interloper
rows.current: lang(Fox): 仿佛注定只有一个目的，那位星际闯入者

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: made their way to the very core of Traeh's prison.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 一路来到了Traeh监牢的最深处。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Had her psychic tendrils found their way into a poor fool's mind?
rows.current: lang(Fox): 难道她的灵能触须已经伸进了某个可怜傻瓜的脑海？

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: There is no way to know if it was dark ESPer power at work or merely curiosity
rows.current: lang(Fox): 究竟是黑暗的超能力者力量在作祟，还是仅仅出于好奇，已经无从知晓，

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: but this traveler made contact with the crystal prison that held Traeh...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 但这位旅人触碰了囚禁Traeh的水晶监牢……

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: ...and so they became undone, unable to resist the dark ESPer forces.
rows.current: lang(Fox): ……就这样，这位旅人无力抵抗黑暗的超能力者力量，最终沦陷了。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Power and pain coursed through the poor explorer
rows.current: lang(Fox): 力量与痛苦流遍了这位可怜的探险者全身，

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: until their mind was no longer their own.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 直到心智再也不属于自己。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: No, from that moment forth they answered to a darker power...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 不，从那一刻起，这位旅人听命于一股更黑暗的力量……

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: They did as Traeh commanded!
rows.current: lang(Fox): Traeh吩咐什么，其便做什么！

rows.source: Woah, you really took a beating, lady!
rows.current: text: 哇，你可真是挨了好一顿揍啊，女士！

rows.source: But you look just as fresh as you did when I first entered here...
rows.current: text: 可你看起来还是跟我刚进来时一样精神……

rows.source: You're really one of those immortal elves, ain't ya?
rows.current: text: 你真的是那些不朽精灵中的一员，对吧？

rows.source: Correct, my young sir. I am Enelye, the Immortal High Lady of the Tutone Elves.
rows.current: text: 没错，年轻的先生。我是恩莉耶，图托恩精灵的不朽至高女领主。

rows.source: I must commend your most respectable performance in the art of combat
rows.current: text: 你在战斗技艺上的表现令人肃然起敬，我必须予以赞扬。即便对我这样年长的人而言，观赏这场表演也十分愉快。

rows.source: it was a highly enjoyable act to watch, even for one as old as I.
It was so enjoyable, that I believe you are due for a reward.
rows.current: text: 实在是太令人愉快了，我想你理应得到一份奖励。

rows.source: So please, sit back and relax while I...
rows.current: text: 所以，请坐好，放松下来，让我……

rows.source: ...reward... you suitably...
rows.current: text: ……好好地……奖励你……

rows.source: H-hey! Come on lady! You gotta be making some mistake!
rows.current: text: 喂、喂！拜托，女士！你肯定是弄错什么了！

rows.source: Aaaaa!
rows.current: text: 啊啊啊！

rows.source: ...w-wait! No! Don't do that!
rows.current: text: ……等、等等！不！别这样！

rows.source: ...n-no no no! I'm a boy! I don't wear these sorts of... dresses!
rows.current: text: ……不、不不不！我是男孩！我不穿这种……裙子！

rows.source: N-not that there's anything wrong with boys in dresses... but... b-but...!
rows.current: text: 倒、倒不是说男孩穿裙子有什么不对……可是……可、可是……！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: D-darn it! Come on Yiffany, don't you remember me?
rows.current: text: 可、可恶！拜托啊，伊吠妮，你不记得我了吗？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: It's me! Your little brother! Darn it!!!
rows.current: text: 是我啊！你的弟弟！可恶！！！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Nnngh... d-don't worry, lil bro, I remember you...
rows.current: text: 唔……别、别担心，弟弟，我记得你……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: But give me another concussion and I can't say I'll keep on remembering you
rows.current: text: 不过你要是再把我打出一次脑震荡，我可不敢保证还能记得你，所以让我缓一会儿，行吗？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: so maybe give me a moment, eh?

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Let me have at least... 5 seconds to clear my head before you swing...
rows.current: text: 你再动手之前，至少给我……5秒钟清醒一下脑子……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: and then I'll be able to throw you to the ground like old times, alright?
rows.current: text: 然后我就能像以前一样把你摔在地上了，好吧？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: You're back! Yiffany! Sister!
rows.current: text: 你回来了！伊吠妮！姐姐！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: All it took was 3 rounds of repeated blows to your head...
rows.current: text: 只不过是朝你脑袋反复打了3轮……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...but now you're back!
rows.current: text: ……不过现在你回来了！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Help me up lil bro, it's not just my head that took the whacking all this time.
rows.current: text: 扶我起来，弟弟，这么一通打下来，挨揍的可不只是我的脑袋。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I was under control of... a dark queen.
rows.current: text: 我之前被……一位黑暗女王控制着。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I feel as if all my energy has been sapped out, now that I'm free from them.
rows.current: text: 如今摆脱了控制，我感觉全身的力气都像被抽干了。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Don't think I'm fit for combat anymore, but here: take this.
rows.current: text: 我想我现在不适合再战斗了，不过，来，拿着这个。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: It's the whistle dad gave me when I first started to follow in his footsteps!
rows.current: text: 这是我刚开始追随爸爸的脚步时，他给我的哨子！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Blow it practically anywhere and I'll be able to pick you up in your ship.
rows.current: text: 几乎不管在哪儿吹响它，我都能开着你的飞船来接你。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: If nothing else, I can be your pilot while you play at hero this time, okay?
rows.current: text: 别的不说，这次你逞英雄的时候，我至少还能当你的飞行员，好吗？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Woah there little guy, what's all this running and jumping around about?
rows.current: text: 喔，小家伙，怎么到处跑跑跳跳的？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: You almost bopped me good a few times there!
rows.current: text: 刚才有好几下，差点真让你揍中了！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Gotta learn to control all that energy that you've got built up.
rows.current: text: 你得学会控制这一身使不完的劲儿。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Trust me, when you're an energetic little dog like you or I, it's basically
rows.current: text: 信我，像你我这样精力旺盛的小狗，这简直就是超能力！当然，我如今可没那么幼嫩可爱了，毕竟我现在可是二十一岁的成年男人了。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: like a super power! Not that I look that young or adorable anymore

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: now that I'm a 21 year old full grown man.

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Still got the energy though!
rows.current: text: 不过精力还是那么旺盛！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I was still just a pup back when I was finishing up the Cosmobreeder program.
rows.current: text: 我完成宇宙育种者培训时，还嫩得很呢。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Prodigy problems, of course.
rows.current: text: 当然，这就是天才的烦恼。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Wasn't allowed to do any hands-on training until I hit 18, but when I finally
rows.current: text: 满十八岁才准实操训练，可等我终于能领用训练器材、积攒宝贵的VR训练时数时，我就在VR室里像你刚才那样，满屋跑跳蹬墙！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: got to sign out training tools and log some valuable VR training hours

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I was in those VR rooms running and jumping off the walls like you just were!

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: To be honest, my first VR session didn't have much running or jumping...
rows.current: text: 说实话，我头回VR训练没怎么跑跳……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: It was a simulation of a previous agent's first sortie.
rows.current: text: 那是模拟某位前辈特工首次出任务的情景。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Makes sense to start with something like that, but a couple of higher ups
rows.current: text: 从这种任务开始练也合理，可有几个上级似乎觉得特别好笑，好像是什么内部笑话。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: seemed to get a kick out of it. Like it was some inside joke or something.

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I wasn't fazed though! Joke or not, I was gonna give it my all.
rows.current: text: 可我没被吓住！管它是不是玩笑，我都要全力以赴。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: As soon as I had the VR gear on and logged into the data steady, it was clear
rows.current: text: 我一戴好虚拟现实装备、稳定接入数据，就明白了，这场测试的对手，就是一只教科书式的科博德。

rows.speaker: narrator
